artworks.title: Two Figures in a Landscape
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with figures standing near the shore. The horizon divides the sea and sky, where birds are flying. The sky has cloudy formations in shades of black, gray, and white. The artwork conveys a sense of movement and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Ruins of the Church of the Saints-Innocents, Paris
artworks.medium: black chalk on tan paper mounted on card
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee

artworks.title: After the Bath: Woman Drying Herself
artworks.medium: charcoal and pastel on tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee

artworks.title: A Man Drawing
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on beige laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a person in a seated position from the back and side. The individual is reclined against a surface, possibly a bench or low wall, with legs stretched out in front and crossed at the ankles. They are holding a book or similar object with both hands. The person's facial features are not visible due to the angle, but their head is tilted slightly forward. They are wearing voluminous, loose-fitting robes. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Ludlow Castle, Shropshire
artworks.medium: watercolor over traces of graphite on paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring a castle on the right side. The viewer can observe the rough terrain leading up to the fortress, which is situated on a slight elevation. The horizon is not prominently visible. The castle has sturdy battlements and towers. The painting has detailed brushstrokes depicting textures of stone and foliage. The color palette includes earthy tones with soft greens and blues. A lone figure on horseback is seen on the path to the castle, and a small group of livestock is grazing further away. The background merges into a sky rendered with a gentle wash.

artworks.title: David Playing the Harp Before Saul
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with black chalk and brown wash, heightened with white gouache on blue paper, squared in black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a regal scene with a seated figure and accompanying attendants. The central figure sits on an elaborate throne, adorned with a crown and draped in robes. Surrounding this figure are several others, some in ornate armor and holding various items like spears or banners. The figures stand in a structured composition, some appearing motionless while others stride toward the central throne. This artistic work utilizes a limited color palette with fine lines and detailed etchings.

artworks.title: Design for a Ceiling: Aeolus Seated on Clouds Surrounded by Putti
artworks.medium: black, white, and red chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring multiple cherubic figures and a central seated figure with outstretched arms. The image is characterized by the use of a blue-grey paper with white highlights and red chalk line work. A key element is the central figure seated on what appears to be a cloud or rocky surface, reaching upwards. Surrounding this figure are several cherub-like entities. The lower portion is adorned with fruits and flora. The use of contrasting lines and soft shading creates depth in the ethereal setting.

artworks.title: Tower Falls, 110 Feet. Yellowstone National Park
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfall cascading down between large rock formations. The perspective highlights the vertical plunge of the waterfall, with rocky cliffs framing it. The horizon is obstructed by the cliffs and trees, which stand tall and are topped by a cluster of trees. The picture is in black and white, emphasizing textures and contrasts within the rocks and water. The waterfall is white against the darker tones of the rocks and vegetation. In the foreground, there is a rocky streambed and fallen logs. The composition evokes depth and grandeur, guiding the viewer's gaze along the water's path from the cliffs to the riverbed.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman in a Garden
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro in honor of Sarah Greenough

artworks.title: Nude Study
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund

artworks.title: The Tempest (La Tempête)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a maritime scene with barrels on land, two figures in a boat, a distressed ship with smoke, smaller boats on choppy waters, distant ships on the horizon, trees on the left, intricate linework, and a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: A Roman Capriccio
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Victor Carlson
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint overlooking a grand architectural setting. The horizon is suggested by rising structures and distant pyramids, including an obelisk. The drawing style features loose brushstrokes with sepia tones, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette is mainly monochromatic with light brown and beige. Closest to the viewer are large, indistinct shapes, figures, and vehicles. Further away, a curved colonnade leads to a monumental arch and pyramid structures among bustling figures. The sky has soft, sparse clouds.

artworks.title: Landscape with Three Tall Trees
artworks.medium: black chalk and charcoal with stumping, heightened with white chalk on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Merritt P. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a person rowing a boat towards the center. Trees are visible at the horizon, with some tall trees on the right side. The brushstrokes are loose and sketch-like, creating a monochromatic palette dominated by black and grey. The sky features soft brushstrokes indicating clouds.

artworks.title: Pi-wy-ack (Cataract of Diamonds), Vernal Falls, Yosemite Valley, California
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Clinton and Jean Wright Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall streaming between trees, with water flowing over rocks in the foreground. The viewpoint is from below the falls, looking upwards towards the cascading water from a distance. The scene conveys depth as the viewer's eye follows the water's path to the edge. The horizon is hidden by trees and rocks around the waterfall. The monochrome sepia palette highlights the textures of the trees and rocks, creating a timeless feel. The water appears smooth, contrasting the rough surfaces of the rocks. The image captures the power and beauty of nature, focusing on the interaction between the water and the landscape.

artworks.title: The Chiaia and St. Elmo from the Mergellina, Naples
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal town in sepia tones. The view is from a slightly elevated point looking down towards the curved shoreline. A young figure stands in shallow water, looking towards distant buildings. The horizon is in the upper third of the image with water meeting hills with buildings and a cloudy sky. The shoreline has small boats and extends along buildings towards the right. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and tan. The texture of hills, buildings, and boats is detailed, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Tobit Burying the Dead
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of black chalk on laid paper, laid down on old album mount
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four individuals interacting. The scene captures a moment with expressive gestures and movement. Ink washes are used to emphasize contours and musculature, suggesting a struggle. The background includes architectural elements and foliage. The artwork is in monochrome.

artworks.title: A Female Figure Seated on an Entablature, Holding a Distaff
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in dynamic poses on an architecturally elaborate structure. The composition features two figures, one prominently positioned in the foreground with the back turned towards the viewer, appearing to be in motion as if ascending or descending the large scroll-like, ornamental structure. The other figure is partially visible, looking over their shoulder from behind the structure. The drawing utilizes soft and fluid pencil lines to convey movement and energy, as well as to define the figures' musculature and draped cloth. The background appears faint and less defined, with swirling lines suggesting fabric or a flowing element, emphasizing the sense of upward or swirling motion. The architectural elements featured in the drawing contribute to a sense of grandeur and complexity. The sketch composition suggests an expressive and potentially classical narrative theme, evoking a dynamic interaction between the figures and their surrounding environment.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and black chalk, heightened with white gouache on gray-blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of  Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set in an ancient amphitheater. Various classical figures are depicted engaging in different activities. A central character lies on a raised platform, surrounded by expressive figures. Above, winged figures are seen floating on clouds. The arches of the amphitheater are filled with observing figures. The characters are dressed in ancient Roman or Greek attire, and the drawing uses strong contrasts of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Hin-han-du-ta, The Red Owl, a Chief of the Mde-wa-kan-ton Sioux
artworks.artist: Julian Vannerson, James E. McClees Studio
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing from the knees up. The individual faces forward with eyes closed, head slightly turned. They have long hair styled in two braids with decorative feathers. The person wears a dark coat over a light shirt with a bow tie and a blanket across the chest. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Reverie: Young Woman Sitting by the Sea
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a wooden bench. She is facing left, with her body and face in profile. She has a large hat with a feather, a long dress, and a cape or shawl over her shoulders. She is holding a bouquet of flowers. In the background, there is a village with rooftops and sailboat silhouettes on the water under a setting sun.

artworks.title: View of a Shore
artworks.medium: etching with monoprint inking on Chinese paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a coastal landscape. Dark trees with intricate foliage are on the left. The horizon line crosses the midsection, with the sea extending into the distance. A sailboat is on the water, and distant hills rise against the sky. The color palette is black, gray, and white. The sky has light, sweeping lines indicating subtle cloud formations.

artworks.title: Rue de Vaux, Le Mans
artworks.medium: color aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a nocturnal scene of a narrow street flanked by old buildings. The horizon is unclear, with buildings converging towards the center. The painting shows a smooth application of deep green and teal colors, creating a tranquil atmosphere. Stars are visible in the night sky. The buildings' architectural details are mostly obscured in darkness, except for a window emitting a warm orange glow on the left.

artworks.title: Tomb with Death Standing
artworks.medium: etching with black wash on laid paper (proof)
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an underground chamber. The scene depicts a central figure standing behind or emerging from a large, geometric sarcophagus. The figure is surrounded by smoke or mist. Flanking the central figure, there are two large sculptures of seated lions facing each other on stone pedestals. The chamber is constructed of large stone blocks, and the floor is made of tiled stones. The walls curve to form an arch above the sarcophagus, and there are hieroglyphics etched into the pedestal in front of the sarcophagus. The drawing has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: La Jolerie
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lee Gallery in honor of Mack Lee
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a stone building on the right, a person sitting near the entrance, a wooden cart on a dirt path, another cart in the background, and trees in the distance. A pond in the foreground reflects part of the environment. The sky occupies a large part of the upper half of the image. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing textures and shadows.
